message: I have this one friend who goes into full-on panic mode at the first hint of a storm. While I’m over here just making sure we have extra snacks and candles, she’s building an ark in her backyard. I guess we balance each other out—her enthusiasm for preparedness and my calm acceptance that life will unfold as it does. It’s a good reminder that a little prep can go a long way, even if it doesn’t involve creating a boat. How do you handle storm season?
